body: Kesi S014 releases B-2026-11-01-26 — the durable per-turn execution trace — product commit bcef13de (22 files, +2,483/−17): (a) the per-turn event stream persists verbatim (turn_id + seq, turn_traces store, 32KB per-event cap with _truncated marker, newest-30-turns retention, session cascade, persisted on abort/crash too); (b) adapter-level model_call stamps on every path via ModelCallWatch (submitted / response / first byte / completed-failed, per-call usage + payload size+sha never contents, 429 retries visible; the heartbeat's provider_call_start/first_byte now fire from the same watch on loop turns too, epoch-ms anchored beside the labelled monotonic clock); (c) path_selected at every routing decision incl. negative ones + context_assembly start/end (turn-init and per-iteration, with sizes) + stage_skipped for never-attempted stages; (d) context_breakdown + post_answer_lanes persist with the turn, trace_id links every turn to its stream; (e) history payload exposes the full persisted telemetry, trace list/replay endpoints land, the export references the trace via traceRef; (f) the side panel's new Trace tab lists retained turns and replays the raw stream. Verified: backend 3,921 passed / 2 skipped (29 new tests), frontend 677 + tsc clean, ruff clean, and the live 8765 harness PASS twice — the three-message experiment reproduces the investigation's routing split with per-call payload sizes on the record (loop ~23.8K chars vs fast path ~2.0K): the 564-vs-6K prompt spread is now measured, not inferred.
